title: Sequential quantum nonlocality sharing under local noisy quantum channels
summary: Sequential sharing of quantum nonlocality (SSQN) is crucial for device-independent tasks in quantum information processing, wherein relaying the post-measurement qubit through a local quantum channel to a subsequent observer constitutes an essential operational step. Here we present a theoretical analysis of noise robustness of sequential sharing for bipartite Bell and tripartite Mermin nonlocality under the influence of local phase-flip, bit-flip, and depolarizing quantum channels.
